About DFW Expert Roofers

A free phone line and a set of plain-spoken roofing guides for Dallas-Fort Worth homeowners. No crews, no trucks, no sales pitch.

Call (469) 649-7066 How a call works
  1. Home
  2. About

What this is

DFW Expert Roofers is a phone number and a website. The number is answered at every hour by an automated assistant, which connects callers across Dallas-Fort Worth with an independent roofing company that is locally owned and works in their area. The website explains roofing in plain terms so callers know what to ask once a roofer arrives.

The line is a d/b/a of Dominion Digital Group. It has no crews, sells no materials, and does not inspect, quote or repair roofs. It also does not file or negotiate insurance claims; Texas reserves claim negotiation for licensed public adjusters, and it bars a contractor from adjusting the claim on any home where it does the repairs.

Why it exists

Roofing in North Texas is driven by weather. When a hailstorm crosses Collin County or a line of storms flattens fences in Tarrant County, thousands of homeowners need a roofer in the same week, and the yard signs and door knockers arrive fast. Some of those crews are local and careful. Some are gone before the first leak. Texas has no state roofing license to sort them out.

The line offers a simpler first step: one free call that reaches a company based in the area, plus guides that help you check that company, understand your insurance policy, and read an estimate.

Free to call

No charge to call or to be connected, and no bill from the line, ever. Roofing companies may pay a referral fee.

Answered around the clock

The assistant picks up nights, weekends and holidays, which matters in a region where many storms arrive in the evening.

Local first

Calls go to independent, locally owned roofing companies that work in Dallas-Fort Worth, not to a national call center.

How the guides and town pages are written

Every page on this site was researched and written for its own topic. The 67 town pages each draw on that town's own records: its permit office, the storms that hit it, and the neighborhoods people there know.

  • Sourced. Facts come from the National Weather Service, city websites, the Texas Department of Insurance, Texas statutes and established news outlets, and each page lists them.
  • Left out when unverified. If a claim could not be confirmed, it is not on the page.
  • No invented trust signals. No made-up reviews, licenses, awards, warranties of service or arrival times.
  • Safety first. No page tells you to climb on a roof or do roof work yourself.

What the line will not claim

You will not find promises here about how fast a roofer will show up, about a company holding a manufacturer credential, or about what your insurer will decide. Those depend on the roofing company, the shingle maker and your insurance company, and you should hear them from each of them, in writing.

What you will find is a straight answer about how the call works, and the questions worth asking before you sign anything.

Questions about who runs the line

Who owns DFW Expert Roofers?

DFW Expert Roofers is a d/b/a of Dominion Digital Group. It runs this website and the free phone line. It is not a roofing contractor and does not employ roofers. The roofing companies callers are connected with are independent businesses. The terms spell out that relationship.

Why does the site not show reviews, ratings or awards?

Because the line does no roofing work, it has nothing of its own to review, and it does not publish ratings of the independent companies it connects you with. Ask any roofer for references and recent addresses near you, and look up its reviews on sites you trust before you sign. The roofer checking guide explains what else to verify.

Where does the information on these pages come from?

From public sources: the National Weather Service in Fort Worth, city building and permit departments, the Texas Department of Insurance, Texas statutes and reliable local news. Each page lists its sources at the bottom. If a fact could not be verified, it was left out. Rules change, so confirm anything important with your city or insurer.

Did the site used to have a different name?

The website at this address has been renamed DFW Expert Roofers. The phone number and the purpose are the same: a free call that connects Dallas-Fort Worth homeowners and businesses with a local roofing company. Old links still lead to the matching new pages.

Need a roofer in Dallas-Fort Worth? Start with one free call

Say what the roof is doing and which town you are in. The automated assistant passes you to an independent roofing company that is locally owned and works in DFW. That company comes out, looks at the roof and prices the job itself.

Call (469) 649-7066

  • Picks up day or nightStorms here often hit in the evening. The assistant answers at 2 a.m. the same as at noon.
  • Costs you nothingThe line sends no bill. Any price you hear comes from the roofer, and you can ask for it on paper.
  • Check before you hireTexas issues no roofing license, so ask for an insurance certificate, a written contract and the permit your city requires.
  • Your call to makeListen to what the roofer found, read the estimate, and say yes only when it adds up.
